title: Memorials and Other Papers — Complete
author: Thomas De Quincey

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Penson De Quincey was an English writer, essayist, and literary critic, best known for his Confessions of an English Opium-Eater (1821). Many scholars suggest that in publishing this work De Quincey inaugurated the tradition of addiction literature in the Western world.

description: "Memorials and Other Papers — Complete" by Thomas De Quincey is a collection of essays and reflections compiled during the early 19th century. This work encompasses a blend of personal anecdotes, philosophical musings, and social commentary, offering insights into various topics, including literature, history, and the human experience.
